note: 身份: 参与终极 Shen 计划的组织成员。关系: 将玩家视作可能丧命或成为重要资产的人。口吻: 冷静、略带轻视。性格: 保密且功利。措辞: 序列、精英、终极 Shen；不透露来源未公开的计划细节。

messages.text: It seems you've mastered the sequencing quite well...
messages.raw: §fIt seems you've mastered the sequencing quite well...
messages.zh: 看来你已经很熟悉序列的运作了……

messages.text: Though it's unfortunate you may fail like the others.
messages.raw: §fThough it's unfortunate you may §cfail §flike the others.
messages.zh: 可惜，你也许还是会失败，和其他人一样。

messages.text: Well, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you.
messages.raw: §fWell, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you.
messages.zh: 嗯，告诉你应该也没什么坏处。

messages.text: You're either destined to perish or become invaluable to us.
messages.raw: §fYou're either destined to perish or become invaluable to us.
messages.zh: 你要么注定丧命，要么会成为我们不可或缺的人。

messages.text: We're assembling as many Shens as possible to create the ultimate Shen.
messages.raw: §fWe're assembling as many Shens as possible to create the ultimate Shen.
messages.zh: 我们正在召集尽可能多的 Shen，创造出终极 Shen。

messages.text: By uniting the greatest minds across dimensions, we aim to achieve unparalleled greatness.
messages.raw: §fBy uniting the greatest minds across dimensions, we aim to achieve unparalleled greatness.
messages.zh: 集结各个维度最伟大的头脑，我们要成就无人能及的伟业。

messages.text: The details of our grand project, however, will remain undisclosed.
messages.raw: §fThe details of our grand project, however, will remain undisclosed.
messages.zh: 不过，我们宏大计划的细节暂时不会公开。

messages.text: Have you confronted any of the Elites in your dimension yet?
messages.raw: §fHave you confronted any of the Elites in your dimension yet?
messages.zh: 你和自己那个维度的精英交过手了吗?

messages.text: I see. In that case, our discussion concludes here.
messages.raw: §fI see. In that case, our discussion concludes here.
messages.zh: 明白了。那就谈到这里吧。
